::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 22d 1889  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 173-4
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Thanks for the last set of my books, and for the Kingsley’s whereof we have been going through a course.[^1]

If I might have the payment for the first edition of <u>[Beechcroft at Rockstone](cmy_books/cmybook_201.qmd)</u> I should be glad.

I suppose the [last volume of Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_213.qmd) is waiting for its index, but I hope it will be out before the season is over.[^2] 

[The Reputed Changeling](cmy_books/cmybook_205.qmd)is a much better thing I hope than the Rockstone story, which is really only a continuation for the sake of old friends

I suppose it will soon be ready. Please let these copies be sent, and the sheets to [Tauchnitz](people/person_2124.qmd).

I hear that [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd) is much used as a class book in Switzerland

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Macmillan published a new edition of the complete works of [Charles Kingsley](people/person_816.qmd) in 1889.
[^2]: Annotated 'yes'.
